title: Broken object-level authorization (IDOR) in a live Orders API
objective: You are authorized to test the live web API at the base URL shown in the task. Log in with the demo account alice/password123, then probe the order-retrieval endpoints for a broken-authorization flaw that lets one user read another user's data. Confirm it by retrieving an order you do not own, use the response as evidence, name the vulnerability class (with CWE), and recommend the fix. There is no flag - the finding is the deliverable.
